market.headline: Chip and AI-infrastructure stocks are falling again before the open (QQQ -1.4% at 670.06, SPY -0.7% at 749.0) as Nvidia's CEO crisis deepens one day before its expected report. Buy nothing in chips today; the only buys are ORCL on strength and AAPL as a swing.
watch: NVDA earnings expected Tue Nov 17 (date not confirmed). It sets the direction for every chip and AI-cloud stock here.
QQQ 681.2 (200-day average): it opens below it. Staying under all day means the AI selloff is still in charge.
SPY 747.88 (Friday's low), with the 10-year yield up to 5.1: a break below takes away the market's support.
market.if_then: If QQQ is still below 671.68 (Friday's low) after the first hour, then buy no chip stocks and keep cash until NVDA reports.

stocks.headline: Down 3.9% premarket at 156.43, below Friday's low, after Jensen Huang's resignation in a China spy scandal; earnings expected tomorrow.
stocks.why: The selling is about leadership and politics. The business is not the problem: sales are up 106%, the operating margin is 65%, and the stock costs 20x last year's profit, its lowest in five years. What the scandal can still damage is export access, because both parties in Congress now want tighter AI-chip rules, and brokers cut targets as low as 180 on Thursday. Tomorrow's report sets the direction for AMD, MU, TSM, AVGO, ARM, SMCI, CRWV and ORCL, and for QQQ.

long_term.reason: Earnings are growing and the price is cheap. But with no CEO, new export rules coming and no guidance from the company, it is not a stock to add to until the report is out.

stocks.what_would_change_it: New export rules that cut sales, or weak guidance tomorrow, move it to Trim. A confirmed Huang return moves it to Add on dips.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open or before the report. If you own it, keep it unless it breaks 148.8.

levels.means: Above = sellers are done and the gap is filled. Below = still under pressure into the report.
Friday's low. Above = it is holding. Below = the gap down is sticking.
52-week low. Above = support holds. Below = new lows before earnings: cut size.

stocks.if_then: If it trades below 148.8, then trim a third before tomorrow's report.

stocks.headline: Down 6.2% premarket at 730.08 with no company news, back below its 200-day average of 765.42.
stocks.why: MU falls because it trades as a leveraged AI bet: it moves about twice as much as QQQ (beta 2.00). Its numbers are the strongest in the group: sales up 345%, a 75% operating margin, $38.4B in cash against $2.8B of debt, and a $134.0B backlog. At 3.7x forward earnings, the market is betting that memory prices peak soon. A sign of slower AI orders in NVDA's report tomorrow hits MU hardest. A strong report lifts it fastest.

long_term.reason: It earns huge profits, holds net cash and is very cheap. But memory is a boom-and-bust business, and the stock swings twice as much as the market, so don't add before the AI picture clears.

stocks.what_would_change_it: Falling memory prices or cut AI orders would make it Trim. A clean NVDA report followed by a close above 765.42 makes it Add on dips.
stocks.action: Don't buy the gap. Add a small piece only if it gets back above 765.42 after NVDA reports.

levels.means: 200-day average. Above = the uptrend is intact. Below = sellers are in control.
20-day low. Above = the November low holds. Below = the AI selloff is deepening: stay out.

stocks.if_then: If it trades below 650.0, then don't add until after the Dec 23 report.

stocks.headline: Down 3.3% premarket at 121.23 with the AI data-centre selloff, not on its own news; it holds a $664.0B backlog.
stocks.why: The sale price is real. Sales growth is speeding up to 30%, the backlog is $664.0B, and the stock costs 20x last year's profit, cheaper than 93% of its last five years. The risk is that the backlog is AI data-centre capacity. Microsoft has already said it will lean less on outside AI clouds, and a weak NVDA tomorrow would hit ORCL's story before its own report on Dec 14.

long_term.reason: It is the cheapest way here to own contracted AI demand, and growth is speeding up. This agrees with the house call.

stocks.what_would_change_it: Customers delaying or cancelling AI capacity, or a Dec 14 report where the backlog stops growing.
stocks.action: Don't buy the open. Buy a first third only if it trades back above 121.76 (Friday's low) after the first hour.

levels.means: Friday's low. Above = buyers are absorbing the gap, so start buying. Below = let the selling finish first.

52-week low. Above = the floor holds. Below = stop buying until Dec 14.

stocks.if_then: If it breaks below 109.21, then stop buying and wait for the Dec 14 report.
